title: Pullback of internal Hom from a finite projective constant module
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and work with sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves $A_S$ and $A_{S'}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For a finite projective $A$-module $M$ (a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module), write $\underline M_S$ for its constant $A_S$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $A_S$-module sheaf $F$, the canonical map [def-pur-sheaf-hom]
$$g^*\mathcal Hom_{A_S}(\underline M_S,F)\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_{A_{S'}}(g^*\underline M_S,g^*F)$$
obtained by pulling back the evaluation pairing and currying with the tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor] and the sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed] (using [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]) is an isomorphism. It is natural in $M$ and $F$, and under this map the pulled-back evaluation pairing is the evaluation pairing for $g^*\underline M_S$ and $g^*F$.
